It’s a calculated scam designed to prey on people who are curious, vulnerable, or simply not expecting to get ripped off.

The worst part? There’s no honesty, no warning, no proper disclosure—just shady fine print designed to deceive. When you try to reach out for help or a refund, don’t expect integrity. You’ll get the same robotic responses, endless excuses, and absolutely zero accountability.

Let me be crystal clear: Nebula is NOT trustworthy. They are not here to give you meaningful guidance or insight—they’re here to siphon your money under the guise of “spiritual readings.”

So, if you value your time, your money, and your sanity, stay far, far away. Don’t make the same mistake I did. Don’t fall for their $1 bait. It’s just the hook to reel you into a much bigger and uglier scheme.

I wish someone had warned me. Consider this your warning.

Nebula = FRAUD.
